case_number: 2024 INSC 978; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NOS. 158-159 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 5542-5543 OF 2023
summary: Contempt petition against respondent for alleged violation of court order in SARFAESI proceedings; secured asset auction conducted after multiple failed attempts; redemption attempt by borrower post-auction; issue of abuse of process and collateral challenge to final judgment; Henderson principle applied; lis pendens examined regarding State amendment to Section 52 of Transfer of Property Act; sale confirmation under SARFAESI upheld against interference; contempt found for wilful disobedience of court order.
legal_provisions_cited: Securitization and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Securities Interest Act, 2002
final_judgment: Contempt proceedings upheld; respondents held guilty of wilful disobedience; sale of secured asset confirmed to petitioner; redemption application rejected; all other interim orders set aside.
